description: SEC EDGAR company lookup: Finds an SEC registrant by ticker, name or CIK and returns its EDGAR profile (SIC, state, exchanges, filer category, business address) with its most recent filings and document links, from SEC EDGAR (free, no key). Source: SEC EDGAR. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: matches[], company{cik, name, tickers, sic_description, state_of_incorporation, ...}, recent_filings[{form, filed, accession, url}].

query.description: ticker (OC), company name fragment (Owens Corning) or CIK
